audience: Finance and ops owners who need maker-checker discipline on every figure

bots.why: Maker flags each invoice with amount, payee, and due date quoted exactly; checker posts match, missing, or wrong from the bank record — both observations sit side by side before any human yes
Reports the usage position weekly — counters, burn rate, and any spend-guard pause named first — while touching nothing

human_steps: Approve every payment — NEITHER moves money, the human yes is the only yes
Bring the invoices and bank records — the pair reads what a human provides and quotes figures exactly
Set caps, thresholds, and approval limits in the app — never in chat, where they drift
Confirm the spend-guard pause rules and who gets paged when one fires
name: Finance Ops
policies: maker-checker separation: NEITHER moves money — maker and checker observations sit side by side before any human yes, and neither side starts a payment or approves alone
spend-guard: a fired pause is reported first and never silently accepted; caps live in the app, never copied into chat
approval: nothing financial goes out without both observations plus the human yes in the thread

routines.name: allowance-report
routines.prompt_hint: Report counters, period progress, and burn rate against last week; name any spend-guard pause first

routines.name: invoice-pairing
routines.prompt_hint: Pair newly pasted invoices against the bank record; post maker lines and checker verdicts side by side, quote figures exactly

tagline: Every figure quoted, every payment human-approved
